title: Recruited by two men to work as an airplane mechanic as cover
summary: Jake Barber tells of Recruited by two men to work as an airplane mechanic as cover, about mid-1990s at Air Force training pipeline; Pope Air Force Base, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Air Force training pipeline; Pope Air Force Base, North Carolina

tellings.quote: somewhere early on in the the pipeline I was approached by two individuals who convinced me that um it would be a good idea if I became an airplane mechanic.

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, says that in the mid-1990s, early in his US Air Force training, two men approached him and persuaded him to become an airplane mechanic. He frames the mechanic job as a cover, with Pope Air Force Base in North Carolina as part of the setting. He tells it as the quiet start of his path into secret work.
